max_title_distance_pt.provenance: proposal 2026-11-16, tune on the real reports

max_note_distance_pt.provenance: proposal 2026-11-16, tune on the real reports

section_heading_regex.provenance: proposal 2026-11-25 (review I3): a numbered section heading of two levels or more and a word of three letters or more; a figure label such as 1.5 V is not a heading. A barrier between two figures

title_line_min_width_pt.provenance: measured 2026-11-27 on R01 F11: a 3 pt sliver at the right edge (glyph or border fragment, no text) was taken as the first title line and read the title as right-aligned; 5 pt drops it and keeps a single lower-case letter at 10 pt (about 5.6 pt wide)

title_line_gap_ratio.provenance: session 2026-11-27, review round 2 finding 5: a vertical gap between two title lines larger than this share of the caption line height ends the title (a blank line is about one line height); tune on the real reports

title_overlap_pt.provenance: proposal 2026-11-25 (plan 17, real check on R01 page 17): a caption whose top lies this many points inside the edge of its drawing is still the title on that side; tune on the real reports

column_min_words.provenance: proposal 2026-11-26 (plan 24, Task 2): a text block of at least this many words defines the page text column (its median left and right edges); a shorter block is a caption or a label

centre_tolerance_ratio.provenance: proposal 2026-11-16 (a tenth of the element width is centred), tune on the real reports
